answer: Audits are recorded in quill, queued in cipher, and ocean publishes the wait time. A farm of 101 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 84 identities per epoch. A farm of 3738 identities would post 1756 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
